tr.td: The applicant shall get the Application Form from Society Office by depositing PKR. 1000/-.

td.style: width:6%; padding:2px 4px; text-align:right; vertical-align:top; font-weight:bold; border:none;
padding:2px 6px; text-align:justify; vertical-align:top; border:none;

tr.td: Processing fee will be charged @ Rs. 100/- per Marla for Residential and Rs. 20,000/- per plot for Commercial.

td.style: width:6%; padding:2px 4px; text-align:right; vertical-align:top; font-weight:bold; border:none;
padding:2px 6px; text-align:justify; vertical-align:top; border:none;

tr.td: All payments and installments are to be made according to the category/size of the plot, as per schedules of payments, through Bank Drafts/Pay Orders/Cheques/Cash.

td.style: width:6%; padding:2px 4px; text-align:right; vertical-align:top; font-weight:bold; border:none;
padding:2px 6px; text-align:justify; vertical-align:top; border:none;

tr.td: The Developer has provisionally offered this plot based on the proposed Layout Plan. The Developer reserves the right to cancel the offer/earmarking/allotment of effect any variations, alterations in the Layout Plan, which are necessary to meet the planning requirements, relevant rules, regulations and any other reason etc.

td.style: width:6%; padding:2px 4px; text-align:right; vertical-align:top; font-weight:bold; border:none;
padding:2px 6px; text-align:justify; vertical-align:top; border:none;

tr.td: The Plot number shall be given through ballot on the payment of entire consideration as per schedule of payment.

td.style: width:6%; padding:2px 4px; text-align:right; vertical-align:top; font-weight:bold; border:none;
padding:2px 6px; text-align:justify; vertical-align:top; border:none;

tr.td: The Plot Price includes land price and development charges only excluding Additional Development Charges and any other charges which the Developer may impose from time to time.

td.style: width:6%; padding:2px 4px; text-align:right; vertical-align:top; font-weight:bold; border:none;
padding:2px 6px; text-align:justify; vertical-align:top; border:none;

tr.td: The Developer has calculated the total price payable by the Allottee(s) for the plot on the basis of total area of the plot only.

td.style: width:6%; padding:2px 4px; text-align:right; vertical-align:top; font-weight:bold; border:none;
padding:2px 6px; text-align:justify; vertical-align:top; border:none;

tr.td: The payment, on or before due date, of Total Price and other amounts payable as per the Payment Plan, accepted by the Allottee(s) is the essence of this allotment.

td.style: width:6%; padding:2px 4px; text-align:right; vertical-align:top; font-weight:bold; border:none;
padding:2px 6px; text-align:justify; vertical-align:top; border:none;

tr.td: Installments after due date from the applicant/Allottee will only be accepted with surcharge at the rate of 1.5% per month (0.05% per day).

td.style: width:6%; padding:2px 4px; text-align:right; vertical-align:top; font-weight:bold; border:none;
padding:2px 6px; text-align:justify; vertical-align:top; border:none;

tr.td: If any Allottee fails to pay two successive installments within the prescribed period, the allotment shall be liable to be cancelled.

td.style: width:6%; padding:2px 4px; text-align:right; vertical-align:top; font-weight:bold; border:none;
padding:2px 6px; text-align:justify; vertical-align:top; border:none;

tr.td: The Additional Development Charges may be imposed due to material increase in development cost.

td.style: width:6%; padding:2px 4px; text-align:right; vertical-align:top; font-weight:bold; border:none;
padding:2px 6px; text-align:justify; vertical-align:top; border:none;

tr.td: For each preferential location i.e. Corner, Facing Park & Main Boulevard Plot, Applicant will pay 10% premium for each category.

td.style: width:6%; padding:2px 4px; text-align:right; vertical-align:top; font-weight:bold; border:none;
padding:2px 6px; text-align:justify; vertical-align:top; border:none;

tr.td: The Developers and the Allottee(s) hereby agree that the Booking Amount shall be treated as Advance Down Payment and may be forfeited in case of delayed payments or non-fulfillment of the terms and conditions.

td.style: width:6%; padding:2px 4px; text-align:right; vertical-align:top; font-weight:bold; border:none;
padding:2px 6px; text-align:justify; vertical-align:top; border:none;

tr.td: The Developer shall endeavor to offer possession of the plot within fifteen (15) months from the date of this application subject to timely payments and government duties/taxes.

td.style: width:6%; padding:2px 4px; text-align:right; vertical-align:top; font-weight:bold; border:none;
padding:2px 6px; text-align:justify; vertical-align:top; border:none;

tr.td: All registration/mutation charges shall be borne by the Allottee along with any other government taxes in vogue.

td.style: width:6%; padding:2px 4px; text-align:right; vertical-align:top; font-weight:bold; border:none;
padding:2px 6px; text-align:justify; vertical-align:top; border:none;

tr.td: In the event of failure to take possession within ninety (90) days of intimation, the Allottee(s) shall be liable to pay security/maintenance charges.

td.style: width:6%; padding:2px 4px; text-align:right; vertical-align:top; font-weight:bold; border:none;
padding:2px 6px; text-align:justify; vertical-align:top; border:none;

tr.td: No construction can be done without the approval of the Design Authorities of the Developer.

td.style: width:6%; padding:2px 4px; text-align:right; vertical-align:top; font-weight:bold; border:none;
padding:2px 6px; text-align:justify; vertical-align:top; border:none;

tr.td: The applicant shall submit his building plan to the Developer for onward submission to the competent authority.

td.style: width:6%; padding:2px 4px; text-align:right; vertical-align:top; font-weight:bold; border:none;
padding:2px 6px; text-align:justify; vertical-align:top; border:none;

tr.td: It shall be incumbent upon the Allottee(s) to comply with all terms and conditions of the Developer, failing which the provisional allotment may stand cancelled.

td.style: width:6%; padding:2px 4px; text-align:right; vertical-align:top; font-weight:bold; border:none;
padding:2px 6px; text-align:justify; vertical-align:top; border:none;

tr.td: The Allottee(s) shall inform the Developer in writing of any change in mailing address within seven (7) days.

td.style: width:6%; padding:2px 4px; text-align:right; vertical-align:top; font-weight:bold; border:none;
padding:2px 6px; text-align:justify; vertical-align:top; border:none;

tr.td: The Allottee(s) agree and surrender in favor of the Developer any right to receive interest/mark-up against the amounts paid by him/them.
